# Raghav Goyal's Personal Portfolio

> A bold, dark-mode portfolio site showcasing Raghav Goyal's expertise in influencer marketing, brand partnerships, AI-powered growth tools, and entrepreneurial ventures — including Influencer Connect, AI Forge Incubator, and The 3AM Show podcast.

Raghav Goyal is a marketing and partnerships professional specializing in influencer marketing, brand collaborations, and AI-powered growth tools. He is the founder of Influencer Connect, a participant in the AI Forge Incubator, and host of The 3AM Show podcast. This portfolio site serves as a hub for his professional presence, projects, and contact information.

## Pages

- [/](/): Home — Hero section with personal introduction, key stats, and call-to-action.
- [/about](/about): About — Background, values, and professional philosophy.
- [/experience](/experience): Experience — Marketing and partnership roles, career timeline.
- [/projects](/projects): Projects — Influencer Connect, AI Forge, and other ventures.
- [/skills](/skills): Skills — Technical and soft skills, tools, and methodologies.
- [/education](/education): Education — Academic background and certifications.
- [/leadership](/leadership): Leadership — Leadership roles, team building, and impact.
- [/podcast](/podcast): Podcast — The 3AM Show, episodes, and media presence.
- [/contact](/contact): Contact — Get in touch, social links, and collaboration opportunities.
